key.invincible.category.vi: Chìa khóa không thể phá hủy

key.invincible.key1.description.en: Usually performs your main attack or primary combat action.
key.invincible.key1.description.zh: 通常执行主要攻击或核心战斗动作

key.invincible.key2.description.en: Commonly used for blocking, aiming, or secondary combat actions.
key.invincible.key2.description.zh: 常用于格挡、瞄准或次要战斗动作

key.invincible.key3.description.en: Triggers a special ability or alternate skill when available.
key.invincible.key3.description.zh: 在可用时触发特殊技能或辅助技能

key.invincible.key4.description.en: Activates an additional special or support ability if assigned.
key.invincible.key4.description.zh: 若已配置则激活额外特殊技能或支援技能
